section_intro: Village taxes represent {{fact:village-share-of-tax-bill}} of your total property tax bill (per Mayor Mullen, Pelham Examiner May 2026). The school district is the largest share.
note: Note: Village {{fact:village-share-of-tax-bill.short}} confirmed (Mayor Mullen/Examiner). School district is the largest share — no published %. County % unverified. On an equivalent assessed value of $1,045,204, a Village of Pelham homeowner pays {{fact:village-tax-equivalent-assessed}} against {{fact:manor-tax-equivalent-assessed}} in Pelham Manor; the median Village of Pelham bill for FY2026-27 is {{fact:village-median-tax-fy2627}}. Call Town Receiver of Taxes ({{fact:town-receiver-phone}}) for your specific breakdown.

explainers.title: School District
explainers.description: FY2026-27 PUFSD budget: {{fact:school-budget-fy2627}}, voter-approved May 2026. Tax levy rose {{fact:school-levy-increase-fy2627}} — at state cap. Voters approved Props 1 & 2 of {{fact:school-bond-total}} capital bond in May 2025.

explainers.title: Westchester County
explainers.description: County funds regional services — health, parks, social services. Your 14th District legislator advocates for Pelham's share.

explainers.title: Village Services
explainers.description: Village taxes fund police, fire, garbage, roads, water, and building dept. Village of Pelham passed {{fact:village-budget-fy2627}} budget ({{fact:village-budget-increase-fy2627}} increase) for FY2026-27, overriding the state tax cap.

explainers.title: Town of Pelham
explainers.description: Smallest share — covers courts, assessor, recreation, library, and ambulance service shared between both villages.
